import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    # Fix label variants in 'island' (normalize case and strip spaces)
    df['island'] = df['island'].str.strip().str.lower()
    # Convert 'year' to int if it's stored as string or float
    if df['year'].dtype in [float, object]:
        df['year'] = df['year'].astype(int)
    # Remove negative flipper_length_mm (set to NaN)
    df.loc[df['flipper_length_mm'] < 0, 'flipper_length_mm'] = None
    # Parse body_mass_g as numeric (handles numbers with commas and spaces)
    df['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(df['body_mass_g'].astype(str).str.replace(',', ''), errors='coerce')
    # Filter bill_length_mm to allowed range (30, 60)
    df = df[(df['bill_length_mm'] >= 30) & (df['bill_length_mm'] <= 60)]
    # Filter flipper_length_mm to allowed range (170, 235)
    df = df[(df['flipper_length_mm'] >= 170) & (df['flipper_length_mm'] <= 235)]
    # Filter body_mass_g to allowed range (2500, 6500)
    df = df[(df['body_mass_g'] >= 2500) & (df['body_mass_g'] <= 6500)]
    # Drop rows where species is not in allowed set
    allowed_species = ['Adelie', 'Chinstrap', 'Gentoo']
    df = df[df['species'].isin(allowed_species)]
    # Keep id column (assumed to be penguin_id)
    return df[['penguin_id'] + [col for col in df.columns if col != 'penguin_id']]

def answer(df):
    # Group by species (and optionally island if needed, but question only asks for species)
    grouped = df.groupby('species')
    result = {}
    for label, group in grouped:
        # Compute total body mass per group
        total_mass = group['body_mass_g'].sum(skipna=True)
        if not pd.isna(total_mass):
            result[label] = int(round(total_mass))
    # If only one group, put under 'all' as per instructions (but here multiple species)
    # Drop keys with missing total_mass (none expected here)
    return result
